description: This file defines the `CurlMultiHandler` class, which provides an asynchronous HTTP request handler using PHP's cURL multi functions. The class manages multiple concurrent cURL requests, handles request queuing, execution, and cancellation, and facilitates asynchronous operation within the Guzzle HTTP client library.

classes.name: CurlMultiHandler
classes.description: Implements an asynchronous cURL multi handle-based HTTP request handler for Guzzle, managing request execution, cancellation, and event loop integration.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the handler with optional configuration for handle factory, select timeout, and cURL options.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Lazy-initializes and retrieves the internal curl multi handle resource.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Cleans up the curl multi handle resource upon object destruction.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Handles an HTTP request asynchronously, returning a promise that resolves when the request completes.

methods.name: tick
methods.description: Performs a single cycle of the cURL event loop, managing request execution and handling delayed requests.

methods.name: tickInQueue
methods.description: Runs the cURL multi execution inside the event queue to prevent busy looping.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Runs all queued and active requests until completion.

methods.name: addRequest
methods.description: Adds a new request handle to the multi handle, with optional delay.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels an ongoing request handle and removes it from the event loop.

methods.name: processMessages
methods.description: Processes completed cURL messages and resolves corresponding promises.

methods.name: timeToNext
methods.description: Calculates the time until the next delayed request should be dispatched.
